// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.6.11;

/**
 * @title A multi-signature wallet with whitelist, spend limits, and top-up functionality.
 */
contract Wallet {
    // --- Events ---
    event Received(address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event TransferredOwnership(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event AddedToWhitelist(address indexed sender, address[] whitelist);
    event RemovedFromWhitelist(address indexed sender, address[] whitelist);
    event SubmittedWhitelistAddition(address[] whitelist, bytes32 hash);
    event SubmittedWhitelistRemoval(address[] whitelist, bytes32 hash);
    event CancelledWhitelistAddition(address indexed sender, bytes32 hash);
    event CancelledWhitelistRemoval(address indexed sender, bytes32 hash);
    event SetTopUpLimit(address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event SubmittedTopUpLimitChange(uint256 amount);
    event CancelledTopUpLimitChange(address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event SetSpendLimit(address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event SubmittedSpendLimitChange(uint256 amount);
    event CancelledSpendLimitChange(address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event ExecutedTransaction(address indexed to, uint256 value, bytes data);
    event Transferred(address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event BulkTransferred(address indexed sender, address[] recipients);
    event ToppedUpGas(address indexed owner, address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event UpdatedSpendAvailable();

    // --- Storage ---
    // Slot 0: Owner (20 bytes) | Transferable (1 byte, offset 20)
    address private _owner;
    bool private _transferable;

    // Slot 1: Controller (20 bytes)
    address private _controller;

    // Slot 2: Resolver (20 bytes)
    address private _resolver;

    // Slot 3: Mapping for whitelist
    mapping(address => bool) private _whitelist;

    // Slot 4: Pending whitelist addition array
    address[] private _pendingWhitelistAddition;

    // Slot 5: Pending whitelist removal array
    address[] private _pendingWhitelistRemoval;

    // Slot 6: Whitelist status (1 byte) | Whitelist initialized (1 byte, offset 1) | Whitelist operation submitted (1 byte, offset 2)
    bool private _whitelistInitialized;
    bool private _whitelistOperationSubmitted;

    // Slot 7: Spend available
    uint256 private _spendAvailable;

    // Slot 8: Spend limit update timestamp
    uint256 private _spendLimitUpdateTime;

    // Slot 9: Spend limit
    uint256 private _spendLimit;

    // Slot 10: Pending spend limit
    uint256 private _pendingSpendLimit;

    // Slot 11: Spend limit initialized (1 byte) | Spend limit submitted (1 byte, offset 1)
    bool private _spendLimitInitialized;
    bool private _spendLimitSubmitted;

    // Slot 12: ENS node
    bytes32 private _node;

    // Slot 13: Top up limit
    uint256 private _topUpLimit;

    // Slot 14: Top up limit update timestamp
    uint256 private _topUpLimitUpdateTime;

    // Slot 15: Available top up limit
    uint256 private _topUpAvailable;

    // Slot 16: Pending top up limit
    uint256 private _pendingTopUpLimit;

    // Slot 17: Top up limit initialized (1 byte) | Top up limit submitted (1 byte, offset 1)
    bool private _topUpLimitInitialized;
    bool private _topUpLimitSubmitted;

    // --- Modifiers ---
    modifier onlyOwnerOrController() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner || msg.sender == _controller, "sender is neither an owner nor a controller");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == _owner, "sender is not an owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyWhitelisted() {
        require(_whitelist[msg.sender], "sender is not whitelisted");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotWhitelistOperationSubmitted() {
        require(!_whitelistOperationSubmitted, "whitelist operation has already been submitted");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenWhitelistInitialized() {
        require(_whitelistInitialized, "whitelist has not been initialized");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenSpendLimitInitialized() {
        require(_spendLimitInitialized, "spend limit has not been initialized");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenTopUpLimitInitialized() {
        require(_topUpLimitInitialized, "top up limit has not been initialized");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenSpendLimitSubmitted() {
        require(_spendLimitSubmitted, "a spendlimit needs to be submitted");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenTopUpLimitSubmitted() {
        require(_topUpLimitSubmitted, "a topup limit has to be submitted");
        _;
    }

    // --- Constructor ---
    constructor() public {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        _transferable = true;
    }

    // --- Fallback ---
    receive() external payable {
        if (msg.data.length == 0) {
            emit Received(msg.sender, msg.value);
        } else {
            revert("data in fallback");
        }
    }

    // --- ERC165 ---
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7;
    }

    // --- Owner Functions ---
    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function isController(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _controller == account;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(_transferable, "ownership is not transferable");
        require(newOwner != address(0), "owner cannot be set to zero address");
        emit TransferredOwnership(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        require(_transferable, "ownership is not transferable");
        emit TransferredOwnership(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
        _transferable = false;
    }

    function isTransferable() external view returns (bool) {
        return _transferable;
    }

    // --- Whitelist Management ---
    function isWhitelisted(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelist[account];
    }

    function pendingWhitelistAddition() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return _pendingWhitelistAddition;
    }

    function pendingWhitelistRemoval() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return _pendingWhitelistRemoval;
    }

    function submittedWhitelistAddition() external view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelistOperationSubmitted;
    }

    function submittedWhitelistRemoval() external view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelistOperationSubmitted;
    }

    function initializedWhitelist() external view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelistInitialized;
    }

    function initializeWhitelist(address[] memory whitelist) external onlyOwnerOrController {
        require(!_whitelistInitialized, "whitelist has already been initialized");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < whitelist.length; i++) {
            _whitelist[whitelist[i]] = true;
        }
        _whitelistInitialized = true;
        emit AddedToWhitelist(msg.sender, whitelist);
    }

    function submitWhitelistAddition(address[] memory whitelist) external onlyWhitelisted whenWhitelistInitialized whenNotWhitelistOperationSubmitted {
        require(whitelist.length > 0, "submitted whitelist removal is empty");
        _pendingWhitelistAddition = whitelist;
        _whitelistOperationSubmitted = true;
        emit SubmittedWhitelistAddition(whitelist, _hash(whitelist));
    }

    function submitWhitelistRemoval(address[] memory whitelist) external onlyWhitelisted whenWhitelistInitialized whenNotWhitelistOperationSubmitted {
        require(whitelist.length > 0, "submitted whitelist removal is empty");
        _pendingWhitelistRemoval = whitelist;
        _whitelistOperationSubmitted = true;
        emit SubmittedWhitelistRemoval(whitelist, _hash(whitelist));
    }

    function confirmWhitelistAddition(bytes32 hash) external onlyWhitelisted whenWhitelistInitialized {
        require(_whitelistOperationSubmitted, "whitelist addition has not been submitted");
        require(_hash(_pendingWhitelistAddition) == hash, "hash of the pending whitelist addition does not match");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _pendingWhitelistAddition.length; i++) {
            _whitelist[_pendingWhitelistAddition[i]] = true;
        }
        emit AddedToWhitelist(msg.sender, _pendingWhitelistAddition);
        delete _pendingWhitelistAddition;
        _whitelistOperationSubmitted = false;
    }

    function confirmWhitelistRemoval(bytes32 hash) external onlyWhitelisted whenWhitelistInitialized {
        require(_whitelistOperationSubmitted, "whitelist removal has not been submitted");
        require(_hash(_pendingWhitelistRemoval) == hash, "hash of the pending whitelist removal does not match");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _pendingWhitelistRemoval.length; i++) {
            _whitelist[_pendingWhitelistRemoval[i]] = false;
        }
        emit RemovedFromWhitelist(msg.sender, _pendingWhitelistRemoval);
        delete _pendingWhitelistRemoval;
        _whitelistOperationSubmitted = false;
    }

    function cancelWhitelistAddition(bytes32 hash) external onlyWhitelisted {
        require(_whitelistOperationSubmitted, "whitelist addition has not been submitted");
        require(_hash(_pendingWhitelistAddition) == hash, "hash of the pending whitelist addition do not match");
        emit CancelledWhitelistAddition(msg.sender, hash);
        delete _pendingWhitelistAddition;
        _whitelistOperationSubmitted = false;
    }

    function cancelWhitelistRemoval(bytes32 hash) external onlyWhitelisted {
        require(_whitelistOperationSubmitted, "whitelist removal has not been submitted");
        require(_hash(_pendingWhitelistRemoval) == hash, "hash of the pending whitelist removal does not match");
        emit CancelledWhitelistRemoval(msg.sender, hash);
        delete _pendingWhitelistRemoval;
        _whitelistOperationSubmitted = false;
    }

    // --- Spend Limit Management ---
    function spendLimit() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _spendLimit;
    }

    function spendAvailable() public view returns (uint256) {
        if (block.timestamp > _spendLimitUpdateTime + 1 days) {
            return _spendLimit;
        }
        return _spendAvailable;
    }

    function pendingSpendLimit() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _pendingSpendLimit;
    }

    function submittedSpendLimit() external view returns (bool) {
        return _spendLimitSubmitted;
    }

    function initializedSpendLimit() external view returns (bool) {
        return _spendLimitInitialized;
    }

    function initializeSpendLimit(uint256 amount) external onlyOwnerOrController {
        require(!_spendLimitInitialized, "spend limit has already been initialized");
        _setSpendLimit(amount);
        _spendLimitInitialized = true;
        emit SetSpendLimit(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function submitSpendLimit(uint256 amount) external onlyWhitelisted whenSpendLimitInitialized {
        require(!_spendLimitSubmitted, "spend limit has already been submitted");
        _pendingSpendLimit = amount;
        _spendLimitSubmitted = true;
        emit SubmittedSpendLimitChange(amount);
    }

    function confirmSpendLimit(uint256 amount) external onlyWhitelisted whenSpendLimitSubmitted {
        require(_pendingSpendLimit == amount, "confirmed and submitted spend limits dont match");
        _setSpendLimit(amount);
        emit SetSpendLimit(msg.sender, amount);
        _pendingSpendLimit = 0;
        _spendLimitSubmitted = false;
    }

    function cancelSpendLimit(uint256 amount) external onlyWhitelisted whenSpendLimitSubmitted {
        require(_pendingSpendLimit == amount, "pending and cancelled spend limits dont match");
        emit CancelledSpendLimitChange(msg.sender, amount);
        _pendingSpendLimit = 0;
        _spendLimitSubmitted = false;
    }

    function _setSpendLimit(uint256 amount) internal {
        _updateSpendAvailable();
        _spendLimit = amount;
        if (_spendAvailable > amount) {
            _spendAvailable = amount;
        }
    }

    function _updateSpendAvailable() internal {
        if (block.timestamp > _spendLimitUpdateTime + 1 days) {
            _spendLimitUpdateTime = block.timestamp;
            _spendAvailable = _spendLimit;
            emit UpdatedSpendAvailable();
        }
    }

    // --- Top Up Limit Management ---
    function topUpLimit() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _topUpLimit;
    }

    function topUpAvailable() external view returns (uint256) {
        if (block.timestamp > _topUpLimitUpdateTime + 1 days) {
            return _topUpLimit;
        }
        return _topUpAvailable;
    }

    function pendingTopUpLimit() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _pendingTopUpLimit;
    }

    function submittedTopUpLimit() external view returns (bool) {
        return _topUpLimitSubmitted;
    }

    function initializedTopUpLimit() external view returns (bool) {
        return _topUpLimitInitialized;
    }

    function initializeTopUpLimit(uint256 amount) external onlyOwnerOrController {
        require(!_topUpLimitInitialized, "top up limit has already been initialized");
        require(amount >= 0.1 ether && amount <= 0.5 ether, "top up amount is outside of the min/max range");
        _topUpLimit = amount;
        _topUpLimitInitialized = true;
        _topUpLimitSubmitted = true;
        emit SetTopUpLimit(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function submitTopUpLimit(uint256 amount) external onlyWhitelisted whenTopUpLimitInitialized {
        require(!_topUpLimitSubmitted, "top up limit has already been initialized");
        require(amount >= 0.1 ether && amount <= 0.5 ether, "top up amount is outside of the min/max range");
        _pendingTopUpLimit = amount;
        _topUpLimitSubmitted = true;
        emit SubmittedTopUpLimitChange(amount);
    }

    function confirmTopUpLimit(uint256 amount) external onlyWhitelisted whenTopUpLimitSubmitted {
        require(_pendingTopUpLimit == amount, "confirmed and pending topup limit are not the same");
        _topUpLimit = amount;
        emit SetTopUpLimit(msg.sender, amount);
        _pendingTopUpLimit = 0;
        _topUpLimitSubmitted = false;
    }

    function cancelTopUpLimit(uint256 amount) external onlyWhitelisted whenTopUpLimitSubmitted {
        require(_pendingTopUpLimit == amount, "pending and cancelled topup limits dont match");
        emit CancelledTopUpLimitChange(msg.sender, amount);
        _pendingTopUpLimit = 0;
        _topUpLimitSubmitted = false;
    }

    function topUpGas(uint256 amount) external onlyOwnerOrController {
        require(amount > 0, "provided value cannot be zero");
        require(_topUpAvailable >= amount, "available top up limit less than amount passed in");
        _topUpAvailable -= amount;
        (bool success, ) = tx.origin.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "ETH transfer failed");
        emit ToppedUpGas(_owner, msg.sender, amount);
    }

    // --- Transaction Execution ---
    function balance(address token) external view returns (uint256) {
        if (token == address(0)) {
            return address(this).balance;
        }
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x70a08231, address(this)));
        require(success, "balance call failed");
        return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
    }

    function executeTransaction(address to, uint256 value, bytes memory data, bool isTokenTransfer) external onlyWhitelisted {
        require(to != address(0), "_to address cannot be set to 0x0");
        _updateSpendAvailable();

        if (isTokenTransfer) {
            bytes4 selector;
            assembly { selector := mload(add(data, 0x20)) }
            if (selector == 0xa9059cbb || selector == 0x095ea7b3) {
                address recipient;
                uint256 amount;
                assembly {
                    recipient := mload(add(data, 0x24))
                    amount := mload(add(data, 0x44))
                }
                
                uint256 available = _checkAllowance(to);
                if (available < amount) {
                    uint256 limit = spendAvailable();
                    require(limit >= amount, "transfer amount exceeds available spend limit");
                    _spendAvailable = limit - amount;
                }
                
                (bool success, ) = to.call(data);
                require(success, "ERC20 token transfer was unsuccessful");
                emit Transferred(recipient, amount);
            }
        } else {
            uint256 limit = spendAvailable();
            require(limit >= value, "transfer amount exceeds available spend limit");
            _spendAvailable = limit - value;
            
            (bool success, ) = to.call{value: value}(data);
            require(success, "executing transaction failed");
            emit ExecutedTransaction(to, value, data);
        }
    }

    function bulkTransfer(address token, address[] memory recipients) external onlyWhitelisted {
        require(recipients.length > 0, "asset array should be non-empty");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            uint256 amount;
            if (token == address(0)) {
                amount = address(this).balance;
            } else {
                (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x70a08231, address(this)));
                require(success, "balance call failed");
                amount = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
            }
            _transfer(token, recipients[i], amount);
        }
        emit BulkTransferred(msg.sender, recipients);
    }

    function transfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) external onlyWhitelisted {
        require(amount > 0, "provided value cannot be zero");
        require(to != address(0), "_to address cannot be set to 0x0");
        _updateSpendAvailable();
        
        uint256 available = _checkAllowance(token);
        if (available < amount) {
            uint256 limit = spendAvailable();
            require(limit >= amount, "transfer amount exceeds available spend limit");
            _spendAvailable = limit - amount;
        }
        
        _transfer(token, to, amount);
        emit Transferred(to, amount);
    }

    function _transfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (token == address(0)) {
            (bool success, ) = to.call{value: amount}("");
            require(success, "ETH transfer failed");
        } else {
            (bool success, ) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0xa9059cbb, to, amount));
            require(success, "ERC20 token transfer was unsuccessful");
        }
    }

    function _checkAllowance(address token) internal returns (uint256) {
        if (!_whitelist[token]) {
            address resolver = _resolver;
            require(resolver != address(0) && isContract(resolver), "executeTransaction for a contract: call to non-contract");
            require(isContract(token), "executeTransaction for a non-contract: call to contract");
            
            (bool successA, bytes memory dataA) = resolver.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x0178b8bf, _node));
            require(successA, "resolver call failed");
            address ensResolver = abi.decode(dataA, (address));
            
            (bool successB, bytes memory dataB) = ensResolver.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x3b3b57de, _node));
            require(successB, "addr call failed");
            address ensAddr = abi.decode(dataB, (address));
            
            (bool successC, bytes memory dataC) = ensAddr.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x67c6e39c, token, uint256(0)));
            require(successC, "convert call failed");
            (uint256 convertedAmount, ) = abi.decode(dataC, (uint256, uint256));
            
            return convertedAmount;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    function isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        return account.code.length > 0;
    }

    // --- Helpers ---
    function WALLET_VERSION() external pure returns (string memory) {
        return "1.5.8";
    }

    function _hash(address[] memory arr) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(arr));
    }
}

contract ENSNFT is Ownable, IERC721, IERC721Metadata, IERC721Enumerable, IERC165 {
    // Events
    event ControllerAdded(address indexed controller);
    event ControllerRemoved(address indexed controller);
    event BaseUpdated(address indexed oldBase, address indexed newBase);
    event RegistryUpdated(address indexed oldRegistry, address indexed newRegistry);
    event ResolverUpdated(address indexed node, address indexed resolver);
    event DomainReclaimed(uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event DomainTransferred(address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Reclaimed(address indexed owner, address indexed controller, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event NameRegistered(address indexed owner, address indexed registrar, bytes32 indexed node, string name, uint256 tokenId);
    event CallForwarwedToResolver(address indexed node, bytes data, bytes result);
    event MigrationFinished();
    event BaseURI(string oldBaseURI, string newBaseURI);

    // Constants
    bytes4 private constant _ERC721_RECEIVED = 0x150b7a02;
    bytes4 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721 = 0x80ac58cd;
    bytes4 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721_METADATA = 0x5b5e139f;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;

    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _ownedTokensIndex;

    mapping(bytes32 => address) private _ensRegistry;
    mapping(bytes32 => address) private _resolvers;
    mapping(bytes32 => bool) private _migrated;

    bytes32 private _topdomain;
    string private _topdomainName;
    bytes32 private _domainNameHash;
    bool private _migrationFinished;

    constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_, bytes32 topdomain_, string memory topdomainName_) {
        _name = name_;
        _symbol = symbol_;
        _topdomain = topdomain_;
        _topdomainName = topdomainName_;
        _domainNameHash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(bytes32(0), _topdomain));
    }

    // ERC165
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721 ||
               interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721_METADATA ||
               interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721_ENUMERABLE ||
               interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC165;
    }

    // ERC721
    function balanceOf(address owner_) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for the zero address");
        return _balances[owner_];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view virtual override returns (address) {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
        return owner_;
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) public virtual override {
        address owner_ = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != owner_, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(msg.sender == owner_ || isApprovedForAll(owner_, msg.sender), "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all");
        _approve(to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view virtual override returns (address) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: approved query for nonexistent token");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public virtual override {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner_, address operator) public view virtual override returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner_][operator];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public virtual override {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public virtual override {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory _data) public virtual override {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, _data);
    }

        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, _data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view virtual returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view virtual returns (bool) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: operator query for nonexistent token");
        address owner_ = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == owner_ || getApproved(tokenId) == spender || isApprovedForAll(owner_, spender));
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {
        _safeMint(to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory _data) internal virtual {

        require(_checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, _data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");

        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _burn(uint256 tokenId) internal virtual {
        address owner_ = ownerOf(tokenId);

        _beforeTokenTransfer(owner_, address(0), tokenId);

        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        _balances[owner_] -= 1;
        delete _owners[tokenId];

        emit Transfer(owner_, address(0), tokenId);
    }

        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer of token that is not own");

        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        _balances[to] += 1;

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);

        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);

        if (to.code.length == 0) {

        } else if (from != to) {
            _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (to != from) {
            _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) private {

        _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _balances[from] - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];

        uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastTokenIndex];

        _allTokens[tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
        _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;

        delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        _allTokens.pop();
    }

    // ERC721Enumerable
    function totalSupply() public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner_, uint256 index) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _balances[owner_], "ERC721Enumerable: owner index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[owner_][index];
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "ERC721Enumerable: global index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    // ERC721Metadata
    function name() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721Metadata: URI query for nonexistent token");
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_baseURI, _toString(tokenId)));
    }

    function baseURI() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseURI;
    }

    // Helper
    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits--;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + value % 10));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

    // Controller management
    modifier onlyController() {
        require(_controllers[msg.sender], "Only controller can call this method");
        _;
    }

    function addController(address controller) external onlyOwner {
        require(controller != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        require(!_controllers[controller], "The controller was already added");
        _controllers[controller] = true;
        emit ControllerAdded(controller);
    }

    function removeController(address controller) external onlyOwner {
        require(_controllers[controller], "The controller was already removed");
        _controllers[controller] = false;
        emit ControllerRemoved(controller);
    }

    function controllers(address controller) external view returns (bool) {
        return _controllers[controller];
    }

    // ENS-specific functions
    function setSubnodeOwner(bytes32 node, bytes32 label, address owner_) external onlyController returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 subnode = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(node, label));
        _ensRegistry[subnode] = owner_;
        return subnode;
    }

    function setResolver(bytes32 node, address resolver) external onlyController {
        _resolvers[node] = resolver;
        emit ResolverUpdated(node, resolver);
    }

    function owner(bytes32 node) external view returns (address) {
        return _ensRegistry[node];
    }

    function resolver(bytes32 node) external view returns (address) {
        return _resolvers[node];
    }

    function available(string memory name) public view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 label = keccak256(bytes(name));
        bytes32 node = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_domainNameHash, label));
        return _ensRegistry[node] == address(0);
    }

    function register(string memory name, address owner_) external onlyController returns (uint256) {
        bytes32 label = keccak256(bytes(name));
        bytes32 node = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_domainNameHash, label));
        require(_ensRegistry[node] == address(0), "Subdomain already owned");
        
        uint256 tokenId = uint256(node);
        _ensRegistry[node] = owner_;
        _safeMint(owner_, tokenId);
        emit NameRegistered(owner_, msg.sender, node, name, tokenId);
        return tokenId;
    }

    function getTokenId(string memory name) public view returns (uint256) {
        bytes32 label = keccak256(bytes(name));
        bytes32 node = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_domainNameHash, label));
        return uint256(node);
    }

    function getOwnerOf(string memory name) public view returns (address) {
        return ownerOf(getTokenId(name));
    }

    function domainNameHash() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _domainNameHash;
    }

    function topdomain() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _topdomain;
    }

    function topdomainNameHash() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(bytes32(0), _topdomain));
    }

    function domain() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _domainNameHash;
    }

    function subdomains(bytes32 node) public view returns (address) {
        return _ensRegistry[node];
    }

    function base() public view returns (address) {
        return _base;
    }

    function registry() public view returns (address) {
        return _ensRegistry[_domainNameHash];
    }

    function migrated() public view returns (bool) {
        return _migrationFinished;
    }

    function migrationFinished() public {
        require(!_migrationFinished, "The migration has finished");
        _migrationFinished = true;
        emit MigrationFinished();
    }

    function updateBaseURI(string memory newBaseURI) external onlyOwner {
        emit BaseURI(_baseURI, newBaseURI);
        _baseURI = newBaseURI;
    }

    function updateBase(address newBase) external onlyOwner {
        require(newBase != address(0), "New base should be a contract");
        emit BaseUpdated(_base, newBase);
        _base = newBase;
    }

    function updateRegistry(address newRegistry) external onlyOwner {
        emit RegistryUpdated(_ensRegistry[_domainNameHash], newRegistry);
        _ensRegistry[_domainNameHash] = newRegistry;
    }

    function reclaim(uint256 tokenId, address owner_) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _ensRegistry[bytes32(tokenId)] = owner_;
        emit Reclaimed(ownerOf(tokenId), msg.sender, tokenId);
    }

    function reclaimDomain(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _ensRegistry[bytes32(tokenId)] = msg.sender;
        emit DomainReclaimed(tokenId);
    }

    function transferDomainOwnership(address newOwner, uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _ensRegistry[bytes32(tokenId)] = newOwner;
        emit DomainTransferred(newOwner, tokenId);
    }

    function forwardToResolver(bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes memory) {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, uint256(_domainNameHash)), "Only owner can call this method");
        (bool success, bytes memory result) = _resolvers[_domainNameHash].call(data);
        require(success, "Call to resolver failed");
        emit CallForwarwedToResolver(msg.sender, data, result);
        return result;
    }

    function migrateNames(bytes32[] calldata names, address[] calldata owners, uint256[] calldata tokenIds) external onlyController {
        require(!_migrationFinished, "The migration has finished");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            bytes32 node = names[i];
            address owner_ = owners[i];
            uint256 tokenId = tokenIds[i];
            
            _ensRegistry[node] = owner_;
            if (!_exists(tokenId)) {
                _safeMint(owner_, tokenId);
            }
        }
    }

    function ERC721_RECEIVED() public pure returns (bytes4) {
        return _ERC721_RECEIVED;
    }
}

        if (token == ETH_ADDRESS) return;
        if (IERC20(token).allowance(address(this), spender) < amount) {

        }

}

library EnumerableMap {
    struct AddressToUintMap {
        mapping(address => uint256) _map;
        address[] _keys;
    }

    function set(AddressToUintMap storage map, address key, uint256 value) internal returns (bool) {
        uint256 prev = map._map[key];
        if (prev == 0) {
            map._keys.push(key);
        }
        map._map[key] = value + 1;
        return true;
    }

    function get(AddressToUintMap storage map, address key) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 value = map._map[key];
        require(value != 0, "EnumerableMap: nonexistent key");
        return value - 1;
    }
}

library EnumerableSet {
    struct AddressSet {
        address[] _values;
        mapping(address => uint256) _indexes;
    }

    function add(AddressSet storage set, address value) internal returns (bool) {
        if (!contains(set, value)) {
            set._values.push(value);
            set._indexes[value] = set._values.length;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function remove(AddressSet storage set, address value) internal returns (bool) {
        uint256 index = set._indexes[value];
        if (index != 0) {
            uint256 lastIndex = set._values.length - 1;
            if (index != lastIndex) {
                address lastValue = set._values[lastIndex];
                set._values[index - 1] = lastValue;
                set._indexes[lastValue] = index;
            }
            set._values.pop();
            delete set._indexes[value];
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function contains(AddressSet storage set, address value) internal view returns (bool) {
        return set._indexes[value] != 0;
    }
}

contract NFTMarket is IERC165 {
    using EnumerableMap for EnumerableMap.AddressToUintMap;
    using EnumerableSet for EnumerableSet.AddressSet;

    struct Auction {
        address seller;
        uint256 price;
        uint256 endTime;
        address token;
    }

    struct Bid {
        address bidder;
        uint256 price;
        address token;
    }

    struct Offer {
        address seller;
        uint256 price;
        address token;
    }

    address private _owner;
    bool private _paused;
    bool private _feePaused;
    bool private _cancelFeePaused;
    uint256 private _feeRate;
    uint256 private _cancelFeeRate;
    string private _baseURI;
    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;
    bool private _allAcceptedTokens;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _tokenPrices;
    mapping(address => bool) private _acceptedTokens;
    mapping(address => bool) private _listedMap;
    mapping(uint256 => bool) private _hasAuction;
    mapping(address => bool) private _tokenDenial;
    mapping(uint256 => Auction) private _auctions;
    mapping(uint256 => Bid) private _bids;
    mapping(uint256 => Offer) private _offers;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _salePrices;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _saleTokenAddresses;
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _tokenURIs;

    EnumerableMap.AddressToUintMap private _tokenList;
    EnumerableSet.AddressSet private _saleTokens;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Paused(address account);
    event Unpaused(address account);
    event FeePaused();
    event FeeUnPaused();
    event CancelFeePaused();
    event CancelFeeUnPaused();
    event SetCancelFee(uint256 rate);
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event PriceUpdate(address indexed seller, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 oldPrice, uint256 newPrice);
    event Minted(address indexed minter, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price, string uri);
    event NftListStatus(address indexed seller, uint256 indexed tokenId, bool status);
    event CreateAuction(address indexed seller, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price, uint256 endTime);
    event Bidding(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price);
    event CancelBid(uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event CancelAuction(uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event EndAuction(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price);
    event Purchase(address indexed buyer, address indexed seller, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price, string uri);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenPaused() {
        require(_paused, "Pausable: not paused");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == type(IERC165).interfaceId;
    }

    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[address(0)];
    }

    function balanceOf(address owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for the zero address");
        return _balances[owner];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address owner = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
        return owner;
    }

    function baseURI() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseURI;
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        return _tokenURIs[tokenId];
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: approved query for nonexistent token");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner][operator];
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function feePaused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _feePaused;
    }

    function feeRate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _feeRate;
    }

    function feeUnPause() external onlyOwner {
        require(_feePaused, "Fee is not paused");
        _feePaused = false;
        emit FeeUnPaused();
    }

    function feePause() external onlyOwner {
        require(!_feePaused, "Fee is paused");
        _feePaused = true;
        emit FeePaused();
    }

    function cancelFeePaused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _cancelFeePaused;
    }

    function cancelFeeRate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _cancelFeeRate;
    }

    function cancelFeePause() external onlyOwner {
        require(!_cancelFeePaused, "CancelFee is paused");
        _cancelFeePaused = true;
        emit CancelFeePaused();
    }

    function cancelFeeUnPause() external onlyOwner {
        require(_cancelFeePaused, "CancelFee is not paused");
        _cancelFeePaused = false;
        emit CancelFeeUnPaused();
    }

    function setCancelFee(uint256 rate) external onlyOwner {
        require(rate <= 100, "Invalid cancel fee rate");
        _cancelFeeRate = rate;
        emit SetCancelFee(rate);
    }

    function setFee(uint256 rate) external onlyOwner {
        require(rate <= 100, "Invalid fee rate");
        _feeRate = rate;
    }

    function setBaseURI(string memory uri) external onlyOwner {
        _baseURI = uri;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        require(!_paused, "Pausable: paused");
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function pause() external onlyOwner whenNotPaused {
        _paused = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner whenPaused {
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address owner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != owner, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(msg.sender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, msg.sender), "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(owner, to, tokenId);
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        transferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function burn(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burn(tokenId);
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address owner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, spender) || getApproved(tokenId) == spender);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");
        delete _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _burn(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        address owner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        delete _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
        _balances[owner] -= 1;
        delete _owners[tokenId];
        emit Transfer(owner, address(0), tokenId);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
                return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
            } catch (bytes memory reason) {
                if (reason.length == 0) {
                    revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
                } else {
                    assembly {
                        revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason))
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }

    function allAcceptedTokens() external view returns (bool) {
        return _allAcceptedTokens;
    }

    function setAllAcceptedTokens(bool status) external onlyOwner {
        _allAcceptedTokens = status;
    }

    function acceptedTokens(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        return _acceptedTokens[token];
    }

    function tokenAccepted(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        if (_allAcceptedTokens) return true;
        return _acceptedTokens[token];
    }

    function tokenDenial(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        return _tokenDenial[token];
    }

    function saleTokenAddresses(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return _saleTokens._values[index];
    }

    function listedMap(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _listedMap[account];
    }

    function hasAuction(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _hasAuction[tokenId];
    }

    function price(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _tokenPrices[tokenId];
    }

    function offers(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address seller, uint256 price, address token) {
        Offer memory o = _offers[tokenId];
        return (o.seller, o.price, o.token);
    }

    function bids(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address bidder, uint256 price, address token) {
        Bid memory b = _bids[tokenId];
        return (b.bidder, b.price, b.token);
    }

    function _checkTokenAccepted(address token) internal view {
        if (!_allAcceptedTokens) {
            require(_acceptedTokens[token], "Token not accepted");
        }
        require(!_tokenDenial[token], "Token denial");
    }

    function mint(address to, string memory uri, address token, uint256 price) external {
        uint256 tokenId = _balances[address(0)];
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        _tokenURIs[tokenId] = uri;
        _tokenPrices[tokenId] = price;
        _tokenList.set(token, price);
        _saleTokens.add(token);
        emit Minted(msg.sender, tokenId, price, uri);
    }

    function auctionMint(address to, string memory uri, address token, uint256 price, uint256 endTime) external {
        uint256 tokenId = _balances[address(0)];
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        _tokenURIs[tokenId] = uri;
        _tokenPrices[tokenId] = price;
        _tokenList.set(token, price);
        _saleTokens.add(token);
        _auctions[tokenId] = Auction(to, price, endTime, token);
        _hasAuction[tokenId] = true;
        emit Minted(msg.sender, tokenId, price, uri);
        emit CreateAuction(to, tokenId, price, endTime);
    }

    function updatePrice(uint256 tokenId, uint256 newPrice) external {
        require(msg.sender == ownerOf(tokenId), "Not owner");
        require(!_hasAuction[tokenId], "Auction active");
        uint256 oldPrice = _tokenPrices[tokenId];
        _tokenPrices[tokenId] = newPrice;
        emit PriceUpdate(msg.sender, tokenId, oldPrice, newPrice);
    }

    function updateListingStatus(uint256 tokenId, bool status) external {
        require(msg.sender == ownerOf(tokenId), "Not owner");
        require(!_hasAuction[tokenId], "Auction active");
        _listedMap[msg.sender] = status;
        emit NftListStatus(msg.sender, tokenId, status);
    }

    function updateSale(address token, uint256 oldPrice, uint256 newPrice) external {
        _tokenList.set(token, newPrice);
        emit PriceUpdate(msg.sender, 0, oldPrice, newPrice);
    }

    function buy(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_listedMap[msg.sender], "Not listed");
        address seller = ownerOf(tokenId);
        uint256 price = _tokenPrices[tokenId];
        address token = _offers[tokenId].token;
        _checkTokenAccepted(token);
        _payFee(token, seller, price);
        _transfer(seller, msg.sender, tokenId);
        emit Purchase(msg.sender, seller, tokenId, price, _tokenURIs[tokenId]);
    }

    function createAuction(address token, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price, uint256 endTime) external {
        require(msg.sender == ownerOf(tokenId), "Not owner");
        require(!_hasAuction[tokenId], "Auction exists");
        _checkTokenAccepted(token);
        _auctions[tokenId] = Auction(msg.sender, price, endTime, token);
        _hasAuction[tokenId] = true;
        emit CreateAuction(msg.sender, tokenId, price, endTime);
    }

    function bid(uint256 tokenId, uint256 price) external {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction");
        require(block.timestamp < _auctions[tokenId].endTime, "Auction ended");
        _bids[tokenId] = Bid(msg.sender, price, _auctions[tokenId].token);
        emit Bidding(tokenId, price);
    }

    function cancelBid(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction");
        require(block.timestamp < _auctions[tokenId].endTime, "Auction ended");
        require(_bids[tokenId].bidder == msg.sender, "Not bidder");
        emit CancelBid(tokenId);
    }

    function cancelAuction(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction");
        require(block.timestamp < _auctions[tokenId].endTime, "Auction ended");
        require(_auctions[tokenId].seller == msg.sender, "Not seller");
        delete _hasAuction[tokenId];
        emit CancelAuction(tokenId);
    }

    function endAuction(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction");
        require(block.timestamp >= _auctions[tokenId].endTime, "Auction not ended");
        address seller = _auctions[tokenId].seller;
        uint256 price = _bids[tokenId].price;
        address token = _auctions[tokenId].token;
        address bidder = _bids[tokenId].bidder;
        if (bidder != address(0)) {
            _payFee(token, seller, price);
            _transfer(seller, bidder, tokenId);
        }
        delete _hasAuction[tokenId];
        emit EndAuction(tokenId, price);
    }

    function _payFee(address token, address seller, uint256 price) internal {
        uint256 fee = (price * _feeRate) / 1000;
        if (fee > 0) {
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), fee);
        }
        uint256 sellerAmount = price - fee;
        if (sellerAmount > 0) {
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, seller, sellerAmount);
        }
    }

    function _payFeeWithCheck(address token, address seller, uint256 price, address buyer) internal {
        uint256 fee = (price * _feeRate) / 1000;
        if (fee > 0) {
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(buyer, address(this), fee);
        }
        uint256 sellerAmount = price - fee;
        if (sellerAmount > 0) {
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(buyer, seller, sellerAmount);
        }
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token.transferFrom(from, to, value), "TransferHelper: TRANSFER_FAILED");
    }

    function _safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token.transfer(to, value), "TransferHelper: TRANSFER_FAILED");
    }
}

library SafeMath {
    function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 c = a + b;
        require(c >= a, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
        return c;
    }

    function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b <= a, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
        return a - b;
    }

    function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (a == 0) return 0;
        uint256 c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b, "SafeMath: multiplication overflow");
        return c;
    }

    function div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b > 0, "SafeMath: division by zero");
        return a / b;
    }
}

library SafeERC20 {
    using SafeMath for uint256;
    using Address for address;

    function safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, to, value));
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value));
    }

    function safeApprove(IERC20 token, address spender, uint256 value) internal {
        require((value == 0) || (token.allowance(address(this), spender) == 0), "SafeERC20: approve from non-zero to non-zero allowance");
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(token.approve.selector, spender, value));
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(IERC20 token, bytes memory data) private {
        bytes memory returndata = address(token).functionCall(data, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }

    function isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly {
            size := extcodesize(account)
        }
        return size > 0;
    }

    function functionCall(address target, bytes memory data) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        return functionCall(target, data, "Address: low-level call failed");
    }

    function functionCall(address target, bytes memory data, string memory errorMessage) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        return functionCallWithValue(target, data, 0, errorMessage);
    }

    function functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes memory data, uint256 value, string memory errorMessage) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        require(address(this).balance >= value, "Address: insufficient balance for call");
        require(isContract(target), "Address: call to non-contract");

        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call{value: value}(data);
        return _verifyCallResult(success, returndata, errorMessage);
    }

    function _verifyCallResult(bool success, bytes memory returndata, string memory errorMessage) private pure returns (bytes memory) {
        if (success) {
            return returndata;
        } else {
            if (returndata.length > 0) {
                assembly {
                    let returndata_size := mload(returndata)
                    revert(add(32, returndata), returndata_size)
                }
            } else {
                revert(errorMessage);
            }
        }
    }
}

    uint256 private constant _ENTERED = 1;

    modifier nonReentrant() {

        _status = _ENTERED;
        _;
        _status = _NOT_ENTERED;
    }
}

    function _getCurrentPrice(address token) internal view returns (uint256) {
        address pair = IUniswapV2Factory(uniswapFactory).getPair(token, WETH);
        (uint256 reserve0, uint256 reserve1,) = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).getReserves();
        address token0 = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).token0();
        if (token0 == token) {
            return reserve1.mul(1e18).div(reserve0);
        } else {
            return reserve0.mul(1e18).div(reserve1);
        }
    }

    function getHowMuch1WETHBuysOfTokens() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _getHowMuch1WETHBuysOfTokens();
    }

    function _getHowMuch1WETHBuysOfTokens() internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 ethReserve;
        uint256 tokenReserve;
        (ethReserve, tokenReserve,) = IUniswapV2Pair(coreETHPair).getReserves();
        address token0 = IUniswapV2Pair(coreETHPair).token0();
        if (token0 == COREToken) {
            return tokenReserve.mul(1e18).div(ethReserve);
        } else {
            return ethReserve.mul(1e18).div(tokenReserve);
        }
    }

    function getCOREREfund() external nonReentrant {
        require(isLGEOver(), "LGE not finished");
        require(LGEFinishedFlag == 0, "LGE is over.");

        uint256 coreContributed = COREContributed[msg.sender];
        require(coreContributed > 0, "LGE : Nothing to claim");

        require(!CORERefundClaimed[msg.sender], "You already claimed");

        uint256 coreToRefund = coreContributed.mul(1e15).div(LPPerUnitContributedAmount);

        CORERefundClaimed[msg.sender] = true;

        ICOREToken(COREToken).transfer(msg.sender, coreToRefund);
    }

    function getPairWithWETHAddressForToken(address token) external view returns (address) {
        return IUniswapV2Factory(uniswapFactory).getPair(token, WETH);
    }

    function getCOREWETHUniPair() external view returns (address) {
        return IUniswapV2Factory(uniswapFactory).getPair(COREToken, WETH);
    }

    function addLiquidityWithTokenWithAllowance(address token, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(!isLGEOver(), "LGE is over.");
        require(LGEFinishedFlag == 0, "LGE is over.");

        IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);

        wrappedTokenContributed[msg.sender] = wrappedTokenContributed[msg.sender].add(amount);
        totalWrapTokenContributedAmount = totalWrapTokenContributedAmount.add(amount);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferredEvent(owner(), newOwner);
        _setOwner(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferredEvent(owner(), address(0));
        _setOwner(address(0));
    }

    receive() external payable {
        _contribute();
    }

    function _contribute() internal {
        require(isLGEStarted(), "LGE Didn't start");
        require(!isLGEOver(), "LGE is over.");
        require(LGEFinishedFlag == 0, "LGE is over.");

        uint256 ethAmount = msg.value;
        require(ethAmount > 0, "Must send ETH");

        ETHContributed[msg.sender] = ETHContributed[msg.sender].add(ethAmount);
        totalETHContributedAmount = totalETHContributedAmount.add(ethAmount);

        emit Contibution(ethAmount, msg.sender);
    }
}

        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;

        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {

            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (value % 10)));

    function collectionDescription() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _collectionDescription;
    }

    function projectWebsite() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _projectWebsite;
    }

    function balanceOf(address owner_) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (owner_ == address(0)) {
            revert ERC721InvalidReceiver();
        }
        return _balances[owner_];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address owner_ = _ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (owner_ == address(0)) {
            revert ERC721NonexistentToken();
        }
        return owner_;
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) {
            revert ERC721NonexistentToken();
        }
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner_, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner_][operator];
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (string memory) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) {
            revert ERC721NonexistentToken();
        }
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_baseURI, _toString(tokenId)));
    }

    function attributesOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (string memory) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) {
            revert ERC721NonexistentToken();
        }
        return _attributesOf(tokenId);
    }

    function tokenDataOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (TokenData memory) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) {
            revert ERC721NonexistentToken();
        }
        return _tokenData[tokenId];
    }

    function isTokenLocked(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (bool) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) {
            revert ERC721NonexistentToken();
        }
        return _tokenLocks[tokenId] > block.number;
    }

    function royaltyInfo(uint256 tokenId, uint256 salePrice) public view returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) {
            revert ERC721NonexistentToken();
        }
        receiver = _defaultRoyaltyRecipient;
        royaltyAmount = (salePrice * _royaltyBPS) / 10000;
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        address owner_ = _ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (msg.sender != owner_ && !isApprovedForAll(owner_, msg.sender)) {
            revert ERC721InvalidApprover();
        }
        _approve(to, tokenId);
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public {
        if (operator == msg.sender) {
            revert ERC721InvalidOperator();
        }
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        if (!_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId)) {
            revert ERC721InsufficientApproval();
        }
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        if (!_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId)) {
            revert ERC721InsufficientApproval();
        }
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function mintToAddress(address to) public onlyMinter {
        if (!_mintActive) {
            revert MintNotActive();
        }
        if (_tokensMinted >= _maxSupply) {
            revert MaxSupplyExceeded();
        }
        _mint(to, _tokensMinted);
        _tokensMinted++;
    }

    function toggleMint() public onlyOwner {
        _mintActive = !_mintActive;
    }

    function freezeToken(uint256 tokenId) public onlyTokenOwner(tokenId) onlyUnfrozenTokenData(tokenId) {
        _setTokenDataFrozen(tokenId, true);
    }

    function setTokenLock(uint256 tokenId, uint256 lockUntil) public onlyTokenOwner(tokenId) {
        if (lockUntil > block.number + 2000000) {
            revert LockupPeriodTooLong();
        }
        _tokenLocks[tokenId] = lockUntil;
        emit TokenLocked(tokenId, lockUntil);
    }

    }

    function updateTokenDescription(uint256 tokenId, string memory) public onlyTokenOwner(tokenId) onlyUnfrozenTokenData(tokenId) {
        // TokenData struct does not have a description field
    }

    function ownerSetBaseURI(string memory baseURI_) public onlyOwner {
        _baseURI = baseURI_;
    }

    function setBaseExternalUrl(string memory baseExternalUrl_) public onlyOwner {
        _baseExternalUrl = baseExternalUrl_;
    }

    function setCollection(string memory collection_) public onlyOwner {
        _collection = collection_;
    }

    function setCollectionDescription(string memory collectionDescription_) public onlyOwner {
        _collectionDescription = collectionDescription_;
    }

    function setProjectWebsite(string memory projectWebsite_) public onlyOwner {
        _projectWebsite = projectWebsite_;
    }

    function changeMaxSupply(uint256 maxSupply_) public onlyOwner {
        _maxSupply = maxSupply_;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        if (newOwner == address(0)) {
            revert ERC721InvalidReceiver();
        }
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function _ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (address) {
        return _owners[tokenId];
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _ownerOf(tokenId) != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address owner_ = _ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == owner_ || isApprovedForAll(owner_, spender) || spender == _tokenApprovals[tokenId]);
    }

    function _isTokenDataFrozen(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _tokenData[tokenId].tokenDataFrozen != 0;
    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(_ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (to == address(0)) {
            revert ERC721InvalidReceiver();
        }
        if (_tokenLocks[tokenId] > block.number) {
            revert TokenFrozen();
        }
        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        _checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (to == address(0)) {
            revert ERC721InvalidReceiver();
        }
        if (_exists(tokenId)) {
            revert TokenAlreadyMinted();
        }
        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
                if (retval != IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector) {
                    revert ERC721InvalidReceiver();
                }
            } catch (bytes memory reason) {
                if (reason.length > 0) {
                    assembly {
                        revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
                    }
                } else {
                    revert ERC721InvalidReceiver();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _tokenData[tokenId].owner = to;
        } else {
            if (_tokenLocks[tokenId] > block.number) {
                revert TokenFrozen();
            }
            _tokenData[tokenId].owner = to;
        }
    }

    function _setTokenDataFrozen(uint256 tokenId, bool frozen) internal {
        _tokenData[tokenId].tokenDataFrozen = frozen ? 1 : 0;
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

    function _attributesOf(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (string memory) {
        return string(abi.encodePacked(
            '{"attributes":[]}'
        ));
    }
}

    function onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
}

    mapping(address => uint256) internal _usersConfig;
    mapping(uint256 => address) internal _reservesList;

    mapping(address => bool) internal _blacklist;
    bool internal _paused;
    uint256 internal _flashLoanPremiumToProtocol;
    
    event Deposit(address indexed asset, address indexed user, address indexed onBehalfOf, uint256 amount, uint16 referralCode);
    event Withdraw(address indexed asset, address indexed user, address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event Borrow(address indexed asset, address indexed user, address indexed onBehalfOf, uint256 amount, uint256 borrowRateMode, uint256 borrowRate, uint16 referralCode);

    event FlashLoan(address indexed asset, address indexed initiator, address indexed receiver, uint256 amount, uint256 premium, uint16 referralCode);
    event Paused();
    event Unpaused();
    event Blacklist(address indexed user);

    error ContractAlreadyInitialized();

        _;

        DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve = _reserves[asset];
        _validateReserve(reserve);
        _updateState(reserve, asset);
        
        IERC20(asset).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        IAToken(reserve.aToken).mint(onBehalfOf, amount, reserve.currentLiquidityRate);
        
        emit Deposit(asset, msg.sender, onBehalfOf, amount, referralCode);
    }
