        DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve = _reserves[asset];
        _validateReserve(reserve);
        _updateState(reserve, asset);
        
        uint256 userBalance = IAToken(reserve.aToken).scaledBalanceOf(msg.sender);
        uint256 amountToWithdraw = amount == type(uint256).max ? userBalance : amount;
        
        IAToken(reserve.aToken).burn(msg.sender, to, amountToWithdraw, reserve.currentLiquidityRate);
        
        emit Withdraw(asset, msg.sender, to, amountToWithdraw);
        return amountToWithdraw;
    }
    
    function borrow(address asset, uint256 amount, uint256 interestRateMode, uint16 referralCode, address onBehalfOf) external whenNotPaused {
        DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve = _reserves[asset];
        _validateReserve(reserve);
        _updateState(reserve, asset);
        
        _executeBorrow(reserve, asset, amount, interestRateMode, referralCode, onBehalfOf);
        
        emit Borrow(asset, msg.sender, onBehalfOf, amount, interestRateMode, reserve.currentVariableBorrowRate, referralCode);
    }
    
    function repay(address asset, uint256 amount, uint256 rateMode, address onBehalfOf) external whenNotPaused returns (uint256) {
        DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve = _reserves[asset];
        _validateReserve(reserve);
        _updateState(reserve, asset);
        
        uint256 amountToRepay = _executeRepay(reserve, asset, amount, rateMode, onBehalfOf);
        
        emit Repay(asset, msg.sender, onBehalfOf, amountToRepay);
        return amountToRepay;
    }
    
    function swapBorrowRateMode(address asset, uint256 rateMode) external whenNotPaused {
        DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve = _reserves[asset];
        _validateReserve(reserve);
        _updateState(reserve, asset);
        
        _swapBorrowRateMode(reserve, asset, rateMode);
        
        emit Swap(asset, msg.sender, rateMode);
    }
    
    function rebalanceStableBorrowRate(address asset, address user) external whenNotPaused {
        DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve = _reserves[asset];
        _validateReserve(reserve);
        _updateState(reserve, asset);
        
        _rebalanceStableBorrowRate(reserve, asset, user);
        
        emit RebalanceStableBorrowRate(asset, user);
    }
    
    function setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(address asset, bool useAsCollateral) external whenNotPaused {
        DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve = _reserves[asset];
        _validateReserve(reserve);
        
        _setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(reserve, asset, useAsCollateral);
    }
    
    function flashLoan(address receiverAddress, address[] calldata assets, uint256[] calldata amounts, bytes calldata params, uint16 referralCode) external whenNotPaused {
        // Flash loan implementation
        _executeFlashLoan(receiverAddress, assets, amounts, params, referralCode);
    }
    
    function liquidationCall(address collateralAsset, address debtAsset, address user, uint256 debtToCover, bool receiveUnderlying) external whenNotPaused {
        _liquidationCall(collateralAsset, debtAsset, user, debtToCover, receiveUnderlying);
    }
    
    function getReserveData(address asset) external view returns (DataTypes.ReserveData memory) {
        return _reserves[asset];
    }
    
    function getReservesList() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        uint256 count = _reservesCount;
        address[] memory reservesList = new address[](count);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            reservesList[i] = _reservesList[i];
        }
        return reservesList;
    }
    
    function getAddressesProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return ADDRESSES_PROVIDER;
    }
    
    function getReserveNormalizedIncome(address asset) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _reserves[asset].currentLiquidityRate;
    }
    
    function getReserveNormalizedVariableDebt(address asset) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _reserves[asset].currentVariableBorrowRate;
    }
    
    function getUserConfiguration(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _usersConfig[user];
    }
    
    function getUserAccountData(address user) external view returns (uint256 totalCollateralETH, uint256 totalDebtETH, uint256 availableBorrowsETH, uint256 currentLiquidationThreshold, uint256 ltv, uint256 healthFactor) {
        return _getUserAccountData(user);
    }
    
    function initReserve(address asset, address aToken, address stableDebtToken, address variableDebtToken, address interestRateStrategyAddress) external onlyConfigurator {
        _initReserve(asset, aToken, stableDebtToken, variableDebtToken, interestRateStrategyAddress);
    }
    
    function setReserveInterestRateStrategyAddress(address asset, address strategy) external onlyConfigurator {
        _reserves[asset].interestRateStrategyAddress = strategy;
    }
    
    function setConfiguration(address asset, uint256 configuration) external onlyConfigurator {
        _reserves[asset].baseLTVasCollateral = configuration;
    }
    
    function setPause(bool paused) external onlyConfigurator {
        _paused = paused;
        if (paused) {
            emit Paused();
        } else {
            emit Unpaused();
        }
    }
    
    function finalizeTransfer(address asset, address from, address to, uint256 amount, uint256 balanceFromBefore, uint256 balanceToBefore) external {
        // Transfer finalization logic
    }
    
    function getConfiguration(address asset) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _reserves[asset].baseLTVasCollateral;
    }
    
    function getReserveLimits(address asset) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _reserves[asset].liquidationThreshold;
    }
    
    function isBlacklisted(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return _blacklist[user];
    }
    
    function getLendingPoolCollateralManager() external view returns (address) {
        return IAddressesProvider(ADDRESSES_PROVIDER).getLendingPoolCollateralManager();
    }
    
    function getLendingPoolConfigurator() external view returns (address) {
        return IAddressesProvider(ADDRESSES_PROVIDER).getLendingPoolConfigurator();
    }
    
    function repayAllAndBlacklist(address user) external {
        // Repay all debt and blacklist user
        _blacklist[user] = true;
        emit Blacklist(user);
    }
    
    function mint(address asset, uint256 amount, uint256 referralCode) external {
        // Mint aTokens
    }
    
    // Internal functions
    
    function _validateReserve(DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve) internal view {
        require(reserve.aToken != address(0), "Invalid reserve");
    }
    
    function _updateState(DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve, address asset) internal {
        // Update reserve state
        uint256 timestamp = block.timestamp;
        if (reserve.lastUpdateTimestamp == timestamp) return;
        
        // Calculate and update interest rates
        _updateInterestRates(reserve, asset);
        reserve.lastUpdateTimestamp = uint40(timestamp);
    }
    
    function _updateInterestRates(DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve, address asset) internal {
        address priceOracle = IAddressesProvider(ADDRESSES_PROVIDER).getPriceOracle();
        uint256 assetPrice = IPriceOracle(priceOracle).getAssetPrice(asset);
        
        (uint256 liquidityRate, uint256 stableBorrowRate, uint256 variableBorrowRate) = 
            IInterestRateStrategy(reserve.interestRateStrategyAddress).calculateInterestRates(
                asset,
                reserve.aToken,
                0, 0, 0, 0, 0, reserve.reserveFactor
            );
        
        reserve.currentLiquidityRate = liquidityRate;
        reserve.currentStableBorrowRate = stableBorrowRate;
        reserve.currentVariableBorrowRate = variableBorrowRate;
        
        emit ReserveDataUpdated(asset, liquidityRate, stableBorrowRate, variableBorrowRate, 0, 0);
    }
    
    function _executeBorrow(DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve, address asset, uint256 amount, uint256 rateMode, uint16 referralCode, address onBehalfOf) internal {
        // Borrow execution logic
    }
    
    function _executeRepay(DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve, address asset, uint256 amount, uint256 rateMode, address onBehalfOf) internal returns (uint256) {
        // Repay execution logic
        return amount;
    }
    
    function _swapBorrowRateMode(DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve, address asset, uint256 rateMode) internal {
        // Swap rate mode logic
    }
    
    function _rebalanceStableBorrowRate(DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve, address asset, address user) internal {
        // Rebalance stable borrow rate logic
    }
    
    function _setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve, address asset, bool useAsCollateral) internal {
        if (useAsCollateral) {
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(asset, msg.sender);
        } else {
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(asset, msg.sender);
        }
    }
    
    function _executeFlashLoan(address receiverAddress, address[] calldata assets, uint256[] calldata amounts, bytes calldata params, uint16 referralCode) internal {
        // Flash loan execution logic
    }
    
    function _liquidationCall(address collateralAsset, address debtAsset, address user, uint256 debtToCover, bool receiveUnderlying) internal {
        // Liquidation call logic
    }
    
    function _getUserAccountData(address user) internal view returns (uint256 totalCollateralETH, uint256 totalDebtETH, uint256 availableBorrowsETH, uint256 currentLiquidationThreshold, uint256 ltv, uint256 healthFactor) {
        // Calculate user account data
        return (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, type(uint256).max);
    }
    
    function _initReserve(address asset, address aToken, address stableDebtToken, address variableDebtToken, address interestRateStrategyAddress) internal {
        DataTypes.ReserveData storage reserve = _reserves[asset];

        reserve.stableDebtToken = stableDebtToken;

        reserve.interestRateStrategyAddress = interestRateStrategyAddress;
        reserve.underlyingAsset = asset;

    }
